comment: test-health-1 — e2e checks that run but do not gate (scripts/ci/quarantine.cjs; the battery reports them in their own tier). perf/budgets.json "allow" one domain over: suite + optionally ONE check (a substring of its FAIL label; absent = the whole suite), why, who owns the fix, since, review. A suite red is non-blocking only when EVERY failed check matches an entry (a crash or timeout never is, unless the whole suite is listed). Past-review and now-green entries print as warnings. Remove an entry in the PR that fixes it.
